note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on integration security (Connected Apps, OAuth scopes, External Credentials/Named Credentials, Named Principal vs. Per-User authentication). No screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy -- taught through comparison and a design-scenario Lab. OAuth scope names (api, refresh_token, full), the External Credential/Named Credential relationship, and the Named Principal/Per-User distinction were checked against current Salesforce developer documentation and a recent admin guide before being stated; exact current field/parameter names in the Metadata API were treated as subject to version drift and described conceptually rather than quoted verbatim.
